{{Short description|Italian physicist (1936–2013)}}
[[File:Franco_Selleri.jpg|thumb|Franco Selleri]]
'''Franco Selleri''' ([[Bologna]], Italy, 9 October 1936 – 20 November 2013) was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[theoretical]] [[physicist]] and professor at the [[Bari University|Università degli Studi di Bari Aldo Moro]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://vglobale.it/attualita/16189-un-%C2%ABeretico%C2%BB-che-ha-lasciato-il-segno.html |title=Un "eretico" che ha lasciato il segno - Villaggio Globale |publisher=Vglobale.it |date= |accessdate=2014-01-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140109103712/http://vglobale.it/attualita/16189-un-%C2%ABeretico%C2%BB-che-ha-lasciato-il-segno.html |archive-date=2014-01-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He received his Doctorate / Ph.D. cum laude at the [[Bologna University|Università di Bologna]] in 1958, and was a fellow of the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]] beginning 1959. He was a member of the [[New York Academy of Sciences]] and the Fondation Louis de Broglie, and served on the board of directors of the [[Italian Physical Society]].

He is known for his analysis of the foundations of [[Theory of relativity|relativity]] theory and [[quantum mechanics]].<ref name="autogenerated1">{{Cite web |url=http://www.aip.org/history/ohilist/28003_1.html |title=Oral History Interview by American Physical Society |access-date=2013-02-28 |archive-date=2013-08-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130807080235/http://www.aip.org/history/ohilist/28003_1.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Baracca|first1=Angelo|last2=Bergia|first2=Silvio|last3=Del Santo|first3=Flavio|date=2017-02-01|title=The origins of the research on the foundations of quantum mechanics (and other critical activities) in Italy during the 1970s|url=http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1355219816301174|journal=Studies in History and Philosophy of Science Part B: Studies in History and Philosophy of Modern Physics|language=en|volume=57|pages=66–79|doi=10.1016/j.shpsb.2016.11.003|issn=1355-2198|arxiv=1608.05197|bibcode=2017SHPMP..57...66B |s2cid=118435754 }}</ref> Several solutions have been proposed for the paradoxes pointed out by him.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kassner |first=Klaus |date=2012-12-01 |title=Ways to resolve Selleri's paradox |url=http://arxiv.org/abs/1302.6888 |journal=American Journal of Physics |volume=80 |issue=12 |pages=1061–1066 |doi=10.1119/1.4755950 |issn=0002-9505|arxiv=1302.6888 }}</ref> Philosophically, his position was that of a realist.<ref name="autogenerated1"/> He was in close contact with [[Karl Popper]] who, though very old, took part in a conference on the subject that Selleri organized in 1985 in Bari.<ref>Obituary CERN Courier cerncourier.com/cws/article/cern/56228 </ref>

He had numerous visiting professorships and fellowships, including [[CERN]], Saclay, the [[University of Nebraska–Lincoln]], [[Cornell University]], and Dubna. Also, he was the recipient of a medal from Gdanskie Towarzystwo Naukowe (Poland). During his scientific career, he published more than 200 papers in particle physics, quantum theory, relativity and history and philosophy of physics. He was the author of numerous books and editor of numerous conference proceedings on topics relating to the foundations of physics.

==Books==

* 2009 – ''Weak Relativity: The Physics of Space and Time Without Paradoxes''
* 2007 – ''Controlled Nucleosynthesis: Breakthroughs in Experiment and Theory'', {{ISBN|1-4020-5873-X}}, {{ISBN|978-1-4020-5873-8}}
* 2003 – ''Lezioni di relatività: da Einstein all'etere di Lorentz'', {{ISBN|88-88550-12-7}}
* 2002 – ''La Natura del Tempo: Propagazioni super-luminali, paradosso dei gemelli, teletrasporto'' (''The Nature of Time''), {{ISBN|978-88-220-6251-2}}
* 1998 – ''Einstein, Podolsky, and Rosen Paradox in Atomic, Nuclear, and Particle Physics'', {{ISBN|978-0-306-42739-8}}
* 1998 – ''Open Questions in Relativistic Physics'', {{ISBN|0-9683689-1-3}}, {{ISBN|978-0-9683689-1-6}}
* 1995 – ''Advances in Fundamental Physics'', {{ISBN|0306441632}}, {{ISBN|978-0306441639}}
* 1993 – ''Fundamental Questions in Quantum Physics and Relativity: Collected Papers in Honor of Louis de Broglie'', {{ISBN|0911767835}}, {{ISBN|978-0911767834}}
* 1992 – ''Wave-Particle Duality'', {{ISBN|0306441632}}, {{ISBN|978-0306441639}}
* 1990 – ''Quantum Paradoxes and Physical Reality'', with [[Alwyn Van der Merwe|Alwy van der Merwe]], {{ISBN|9780792302537}}
* 1989 – ''Fisica Senza Dogma'' (''Physics without Dogma''), {{ISBN|978-8822060891}}
* 1988 – ''Quantum Mechanics versus Local Realism: The Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen Paradox (Physics of Atoms and Molecules)'', {{ISBN|0306427397}}
* 1983/1990 – ''Die Debatte um die Quantentheorie'' (''The Debate on Quantum Theory''), {{ISBN|978-3528285180}}
